versions.changelog: Update: re-run after edits; refreshed diagnostic output and report formatting.
Update: run and diagnostics integrated; fixed report output.

Your agent is failing and you don't know where it started. CognitiveBullwhip finds the origin. Scans your agent's decision history, detects where small errors are amplifying into large failures, scores severity 0-100, and tells you exactly which fix to apply. Full diagnostic report with step-by-step logic trace included.
